sentences.text: Janusaurus was an extinct genus of ophthalmosaurid ichthyosaur.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — consists of a partial skull and postcranial bones.
The individual represented by the holotype would have measured between 3 and 4 meters in length.
The genus Janusaurus was described by Roberts et al. in 2014.
The type species of the genus Janusaurus is Janusaurus lundi.
Janusaurus is classified within the family Ophthalmosauridae.
Janusaurus belongs to the subfamily Ophthalmosaurinae.
Janusaurus fossils were found in the Upper Jurassic Slottsmøya Member of the Agardhfjellet Formation in Central Spitsbergen.
In 2019, Nikolay Zverkov and Natalya Prilepskaya synonymized Janusaurus with Arthropterygius but kept it as a separate species.
